[UK] Pokémon TCG Pocket: Dual Fusion 🧬 | Official Trailer
Double your fun with dual-type Pokémon in the upcoming Pokémon TCG Pocket expansion, Dual Fusion! 🧬 

Discover Mega Mewtwo X ex, a Psychic and Fighting dual-type Pokémon, the Water and Darkness dual-type Mega Greninja ex, and other exciting Pokémon! Available October 29 💥
